framing: Except where a digest entry gives an explicit multi-part formula, compute SHA-256(UTF8(domain) || 0x00 || JCS(preimage)). Fields not listed in a preimage are excluded. Unknown fields fail closed before hashing.

request_digest.preimage: the complete closed HistoryKeyRequest including requester_proof

request_receipt_digest.preimage: the complete closed HistoryKeyRequestReceipt including service_proof

request_replica_digest.preimage: the complete closed HistoryKeyRequestReplica with relay_proof removed
request_replica_digest.rule: destination_authorization is included in its closed member/organization-recovery-holder branch; destination arrays and selector sets use schema-defined canonical order

history_traversal_access_binding.preimage: no new digest is computed; each closed branch carries the already registered full-object digest named by its semantic field
history_traversal_access_binding.rule: self request_receipt.request_receipt_digest uses request_receipt_digest; self archive_replica.archive_replica_digest and peer pending_archive_replica.pending_archive_replica_digest both use archive_replica_digest. Member request replicas never grant traversal access. A branch kind/field mismatch or an unknown digest fails closed.

response_capability_commitment.rule: response_capability_b64u is the canonical unpadded base64url encoding of exactly 32 service-generated CSPRNG bytes

manifest_digest.preimage: the complete closed HistoryKeyResponseSigningInput whose content.kind is ak.history_key.response_manifest

history_source_agent_observation_digest.preimage: the complete closed HistoryKeyResponseSigningInput with source_signer_evidence_ref and source_signer_evidence_digest removed
history_source_agent_observation_digest.rule: Native Agent CurrentAdmission current_observation.request_digest equals this digest. The exclusion breaks the signer-evidence content-address cycle while source_proof still signs the complete HistoryKeyResponseSigningInput including both evidence coordinates.

manifest_admission_digest.preimage: the complete closed HistoryManifestAdmission with manifest_admission_digest removed
manifest_admission_digest.rule: traversal_intent_digest binds the request receipt's exact direct Seal traversal and authorized_ranges equal the complete manifest descriptor range union that passed replay-derived T0

source_authority_digest.rule: member and organization_recovery_holder are mutually exclusive closed branches; the RRK branch includes the complete RrkHolderAuthorityObservation rather than a bare digest locator

rrk_holder_authority_observation_digest.rule: holder principal/service and archive_authorization_tuple_digest match the immutable archive tuple; current_holder_signing_ref, accepted_key_evidence_ref and holder_trusted_basis prove current holder authority and need not equal historical tuple coordinates; current_holder_signing_ref and expiry match the outer source proof and relay byte-for-byte

agent_signer_evidence_digest.rule: AgentEvidenceViewLocator also binds the exact Agent verification method, key-authorize Event, active lifecycle Event and complete accepted PCR Seal basis; no singular control Seal or ambiguous evidence Event locator exists

source_relay_attestation_digest.preimage: the complete closed SourceRelayAttestation including service_proof
source_relay_attestation_digest.rule: the release service hashes the exact source-local signed bytes; retries reuse the first durable attestation bytes

release_attestation_digest.rule: the attestation has no nested service proof; the enclosing response-record service_proof authenticates it

response_record_digest.rule: manifest_admission is present only for a manifest; release_attestation is present only for a chunk

send_receipt_digest.preimage: the complete closed HistoryKeyResponseSendReceipt with receipt_digest and service_proof removed
send_receipt_digest.rule: release_attestation_digest is JSON null for a manifest and a sha256 digest for a chunk

lost_record_digest.preimage: the complete closed HistoryKeyResponseLostRecord, including its release-service signer-evidence ref and digest, with service_proof removed

organization_recovery_archive_digest.rule: the digest is the exact immutable archive identity used by archive-set coverage and candidate origin attribution; container_event_ref and replica transport metadata are not part of this object digest

archive_authorization_tuple_digest.preimage: the complete closed ArchiveAuthorizationTuple including accepted_key_evidence_ref and holder_trusted_basis
archive_authorization_tuple_digest.rule: accepted_key_evidence_ref is Event provenance and holder_trusted_basis is the independently pinned complete prior accepted Seal antichain; direct Seal traversal to the archive target proves the effective tuple and no singular activation Seal is carried

archive_set_digest.rule: rows are sorted by (epoch numeric ascending, container_event_ref UTF-8 bytes, archive_digest UTF-8 bytes), duplicate-free, exactly cover covered_range and all share one archive_authorization_tuple_digest

archive_replica_digest.preimage: the complete closed OrganizationRecoveryArchiveReplica with service_proof removed
archive_replica_digest.rule: the archive, container Event, independent exact-one-epoch direct traversal retention, source/holder services and replicated_at are bound; semantic uniqueness is (effective_scope,mls_group_id,epoch,container_event_ref,archive_authorization_tuple_digest), while this full body digest is only the exact-retry identity and cannot allocate a second sequence when replicated_at changes

archive_list_query_digest.preimage: the complete closed OrganizationRecoveryArchiveListQuery with cursor removed
archive_list_query_digest.rule: continuation cursor does not change semantic query identity; accepted_key_evidence_ref and holder_trusted_basis are both included

accepted_authority_view_vector_digest.rule: object property names are fixed by schema; absent optional profile slots are absent rather than null

governance_registry_artifact_digest.preimage: the exact decoded RFC 8785 JCS bytes of the underlying registry artifact named by GovernanceRegistryArtifact.descriptor; the GovernanceRegistryArtifact wrapper is not hashed
governance_registry_artifact_digest.rule: decoded bytes must themselves be canonical JSON, at most 1 MiB, and match the closed descriptor artifact_kind/artifact_id; hashing the wrapper or descriptor would create a different and invalid digest

governance_registry_snapshot_digest.preimage: the complete closed GovernanceRegistrySnapshot with snapshot_digest removed
governance_registry_snapshot_digest.rule: artifacts is exactly [contract-registry descriptor, proof-context-registry descriptor, replay-schema-manifest descriptor]. The replay schema manifest starts from event-envelope.schema.json and event-payload.schema.json and lists every-and-only recursively reachable local JSON Schema $ref artifact in canonical artifact_id byte order; each artifact is fetched separately by descriptor digest, parsed under its registered type and never inlined in the snapshot manifest

availability_event_bytes_digest.formula: <Realm-suite>:<digest of UTF8('ak.availability_event_bytes.v1') || 0x00 || JCS(complete accepted EventEnvelope with unsigned removed)>
availability_event_bytes_digest.preimage: the complete accepted canonical EventEnvelope with only unsigned removed; event_id, actor_kind and every accepted producer/principal-server proof remain included
availability_event_bytes_digest.rule: the receiver also recomputes the ordinary event_digest/event_id from their separately registered preimage and verifies every included proof before accepting bytes_digest; bytes_digest is not an alias for event_id

history_governance_traversal_intent_dige.rule: member_history_delivery trusted_history_base_basis equals the signed request bootstrap basis byte-for-byte; organization_recovery_archive base equals holder_trusted_basis and requested_ranges is exactly one singleton epoch; target must dominate the complete trusted current and base antichains

proof_query_digest.preimage: the complete closed read_request including local_mls_leaves and byte_limit
proof_query_digest.rule: The query is stateless, near-current and explicitly binds exact proof_base_basis and proof_target_basis antichains, the caller's canonical every-and-only public RFC 9420 leaf coordinates and the group_security_frontier selector. Bulk or old epoch activation is forbidden on this surface.

proof_page_digest.preimage: query_digest is the registered domain-separated digest of the caller-retained complete closed read_request; page_body is the complete matching read_outcome with query_digest and page_digest removed
proof_page_digest.rule: The response completely covers the exact near-current frontier selector or is rejected with mls_governance_proof_bounds_exceeded. Deterministic regeneration for identical retained closure and query produces the same page_digest.

release_predicate_registry_digest.formula: SHA-256(JCS(history-release-attestation-registry.json with the single top-level wire_registry_binding member removed))
release_predicate_registry_digest.preimage: all remaining top-level members and their complete descendants, including predicate_registry_digest_rule
release_predicate_registry_digest.rule: No domain framing is added for this artifact digest. Removing or excluding any other member is forbidden, so the registry never embeds its own digest and has no self-cycle.

mls_genesis_transition_digest.formula: sha256:<lowercase hex SHA-256(UTF8('ak.mls-genesis-transition-v1') || 0x00 || JCS(closed mls_genesis_payload with organization_recovery_archive removed))>
mls_genesis_transition_digest.preimage: the closed mls_genesis_payload core after removing organization_recovery_archive
mls_genesis_transition_digest.rule: This is mls_transition_digest for Genesis. Commit mls_transition_digest is the existing payload.commit_digest over raw RFC 9420 Commit bytes. transition_event_digest is always the separate outer Event digest.

ack_token.rule: ordered_ack_entries is the exact strictly sequence-ascending array of {sequence,kind,response_id,entry_digest}, where entry_digest is record_digest for kind=record or the complete signed lost-record digest for kind=lost. service_record_lost is admitted only for a matching lost entry.

archive_cursor.rule: Rows are ordered by holder-assigned archive_sequence then container_event_ref. No cursor expiry or temporary proof-retention coordinate exists; authorization and proof closure live with the archive.
